testCase:
H-07: A menu that stays open after navigation
Goal: Choose the Pro plan from the Pricing page.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/h-07/
STEP 2: Hover over "Products"
STEP 3: Click "Pricing"
STEP 4: Click "Choose Pro"
STEP 5: Verify "Pro plan selected" is visible

plan.title: H-07: Choose Pro through persistent menu

steps.note: Navigate to Pricing through the open menu.
Select Pro without manually dismissing the persistent menu.
Verify that the Pro plan was selected successfully.

reasoning: This test checks that the Pro plan can be selected after navigating to Pricing through the Products hover menu. The plan follows the specified interaction sequence without closing the menu and asserts the final selection confirmation.
